declarations.description:
`<elohim-compute-tile>` — polymorphic compute-capacity tile.

Renders the compute triptych (free / used / stewarded bytes) for either a
hub aggregate or a single device, with **progressive disclosure** matching
the viewer's capability lens.

| Lens     | What's shown                                                   |
|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| minimal  | Qualitative summary ("You have enough." when free is healthy) |
| simple   | "5 GB free"                                                    |
| standard | "5 GB of 15 GB free"                                          |
| detail   | "5 GB of 15 GB · 12 GB stewarded"                             |
| debug    | Above + peer-id / hub-id / freshness timestamp                 |
| trace    | Above + source-route annotation                                |
declarations.name: ElohimComputeTile

declarations.description:
<elohim-context-menu> — Google Drive-style fold-down menu.

MVP: flat list of items. Submenu support (View as..., Where this
leads...) deferred to a fast-follow shift per design spec §7.4.

Accessibility: arrow-key navigation, Enter to select, Escape to close,
focus trap while open, ARIA menu role, focus restoration on close.

declarations.description:
<elohim-default-omnibar> — the fallback omnibar used when a bundle doesn't
BYO its own toolbar. Minimal MVP shape: brand mark + auth indicator.

The session primitive doesn't poll cookies. On `visibilitychange` the
element calls session.refreshFromCookies() so cross-tab auth changes
are picked up opportunistically on tab re-focus. Callers may also call
session.refreshFromCookies() directly after any auth-related event.
declarations.name: ElohimDefaultOmnibar

declarations.description:
<elohim-mention-base> — the generic fallback chip when a specific pillar's
mention element (e.g. <elohim-qahal-mention>) isn't loaded. Renders
title + EPR id from whatever metadata is resolvable, with a subtle
indicator that this is a fallback rendering.

Pillar mention elements (e.g. <elohim-lamad-mention>) supersede this
element when the relevant pillar bundle is loaded. This element is the
safe substrate-level default.

declarations.name: parseStandingRequirement
declarations.description:
Parses the contract DSL into normalized form: outer array is AND, inner array is OR.
Each inner array element is a Standing name.

declarations.name: satisfiesRequirement
declarations.description:
Returns true if `held` satisfies `requirement`.
AND across outer groups; OR within each group.

declarations.name: smokeGreeting

Smoke-test source string — proves the localize pipeline is wired and provides
one entry for the xliff seed.

members.name: refreshFromCookies
members.description:
Re-read the elohim_session cookie and notify subscribers if the
resolved CurrentUserView changes. Call this after any auth-related
event (login completed, logout, cookie set externally).

members.name: subscribe
members.description: Subscribe to session changes. Returns an unsubscribe function.

declarations.name: axeScan
declarations.description:
Scans the element subtree with axe-core. Returns violations.
Fail your test on `violations.length > 0`.

declarations.name: expectKeyboardFocusable
declarations.description:
Asserts the element is keyboard-focusable. Either the host receives focus
directly or focus delegates to a descendant via delegatesFocus.
Throws if focus does not land on the host or any of its shadow descendants.

declarations.name: renderInLocale
declarations.description:
Renders a Lit template under a specific locale, setting document direction
and the localize runtime. Restores prior document state via afterEach (after
all assertions in the test complete), not inside this helper.

declarations.name: scanForHardcodedStrings
declarations.description:
Scans rendered HTML for likely hardcoded user-facing strings.
Heuristic: visible text or aria-* attribute values that are not pure
whitespace, not numeric, and not template placeholder syntax.

Returns the offending fragments.

declarations.name: requiresLogicalProperties
declarations.description: Returns CSS property labels that should have been logical properties.

declarations.name: setMediaQuery
declarations.description: Force a specific OS preference state for the next matchMedia query.

declarations.name: clearMediaQueries
declarations.description: Reset all overrides; restores original window.matchMedia.

declarations.name: effectiveStimulusCeiling
declarations.description:
Computes the effective stimulus ceiling from OS preferences alone.
See spec §2.5: effectiveStimulus = min(profile.stimulus, osCeiling).

declarations.name: measureLuminanceChanges
declarations.description:
Measures luminance changes in an element over time by sampling computed background.
Lightweight approximation: reads computed-style backgrounds for the element and its
first descendant; counts crossings of a brightness threshold. Intended as a
regression-detector, not a real visual analyzer.

For accurate testing, use a tool like FlashTest or Visual A11y. This harness flags
the obvious cases (full-element strobing) and gives a starting point.
